title: Long Read Viromics Amplification Library Preparation (VirION 2)
author: Marie Burris
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5yug7ww
materials: Use 1ul to assess DNA concentration with Qubit.

Use the following thermocycler conditions to amplify the library using minimum of 15 cycles. repeat steps 2-4 of this sub-step 15-25 times 1.) 94 °C 00:01:00 2.) 94 °C 00:00:30 3.) 62 °C 00:00:30 4.) 68 °C 00:16:00, for 20kb 5.) 72 °C 00:16:00, for 20kb

steps.title: Prepare DNA Input
steps.instruction: Prepare 48 ul of sample containing between 1ng - 100 ng of DNA.

steps.title: Prepare End Repair and dA Tailing Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix for the total number of samples (including 0.2 extra reactions for pipetting error) using the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: 3.5 ul NEB Ultra II End Repair/dA Tailing reaction buffer (Catalog #E7546S)
3 ul NEB Ultra II End Repair/dA Tailing enzyme mix (Catalog #E7546S)
3.5 ul NEB FFPE DNA repair buffer (Catalog #M6630S)
2 ul NEB FFPE DNA enzyme mix (Catalog #M6630S)

steps.title: Incubate End Repair Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction in a thermal cycler using the following conditions:

substeps.instruction: 25 °C for 5 minutes
65 °C for 5 minutes

steps.title: First AMPure XP Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform cleanup using AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter Catalog #A63881) at a 1:1 sample-to-bead ratio.

substeps.instruction: Elute in 31 ul nuclease-free water into a 1.5 mL tube
Incubate the final elution step at 55 °C for 2 minutes

steps.title: Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Add the following reagents to 30 ul of DNA from the previous step:

substeps.instruction: 50 ul NEB Blunt/TA ligase (Catalog #M0367)
20 ul BCA from Oxford Nanopore PCR Barcoding Expansion 1-12 kit (Catalog #EXP-PBC001)

steps.title: Incubate Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Second AMPure XP Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform cleanup using AMPure XP beads at a 1:0.4 sample-to-bead ratio.

substeps.instruction: Elute in 15 ul Nuclease-free water into a PCR tube
Incubate the final elution step at 55 °C for 2 minutes

steps.title: Prepare LA TaKaRa Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix using the LA TaKaRa Hot Start kit (Takara Bio Inc. Catalog #RR042A) for the total number of samples (including 0.2 extra reactions for pipetting error):

substeps.instruction: 16 ul dNTPs
10 ul 10x reaction buffer
1 ul LA TaKaRa enzyme
66 ul water

steps.title: Amplify DNA
steps.instruction: Perform amplification using the prepared master mix and DNA.

substeps.instruction: In a PCR tube, add 12 ul master mix to 48 ul DNA from step 1

steps.title: Third AMPure XP Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform cleanup using AMPure XP beads at a 1:0.5 sample-to-bead ratio.

substeps.instruction: Elute in 20 ul Nuclease-free water
Incubate the final elution step at 55 °C for 2 minutes

steps.title: Assess Library Quality
steps.instruction: Check the DNA concentration using Qubit, purity using NanoDrop, and assess library size using a Genomic DNA TapeStation.

steps.title: Barcode DNA
steps.instruction: Add 2 ul of a chosen barcode from the Oxford Nanopore PCR Barcoding Expansion 1-12 kit to 5 ul of DNA from the previous step (ensure different barcodes for samples sequenced together).

steps.title: Final Amplification
steps.instruction: Add 93 ul of the LA TaKaRa master mix to the barcode-DNA mix.

steps.title: Prepare for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Use the amplified libraries as input for the Oxford Nanopore 1D Genomic DNA by Ligation (SQK-LSK109) protocol, starting with the 'DNA repair and end-prep' step.

substeps.instruction: Pool libraries with different barcodes at the desired ratio if necessary
Load 10 - 100 fmol of DNA into the flow cell
